title: GhostCart Finch API: error response (HTTP 401, 422, 429, 502, 503, 504, 500)
description: 401 missing/wrong token; 422 invalid input, image_url_rejected (see reason) or no fashion items in the photo; 429 too many Finch requests at once; 502 product search or the image host failed; 503 not configured or product search rate-limited (see Retry-After); 504 timed out.

reason.description: With code image_url_rejected (422): not_https, bad_url, port_not_allowed, private_address, unresolvable, bad_redirect, too_many_redirects, http_status, not_image, too_large. With code image_fetch_failed (502/504): connect_failed, http_status, timeout, fetch_failed.
